name: Vanna AI
description: Turns natural-language questions into SQL and answers by chatting with a SQL database using agentic retrieval over schema and example queries.
features: Retrieval over schema and example queries
Self-hostable Python library; hosted offering available

name: WrenAI
description: Open-source generative BI engine that gives AI agents a governed semantic layer (MDL) and context layer to turn business questions into SQL and dashboards across 22+ data sources.
features: MDL semantic layer for governed metrics

name: DB-GPT
description: Open-source agentic AI data assistant that connects to databases and other data sources, writes SQL autonomously from natural language, and generates reports and analysis.
features: Autonomous SQL writing from natural language
AWEL agentic workflow language and RAG support

name: Dataherald
description: Natural language-to-SQL engine built for enterprise-level question answering over relational data, exposed through an API.

name: Defog SQLCoder
description: Family of open large language models fine-tuned for converting natural-language questions into SQL queries.
features: Text-to-SQL model family in multiple sizes
From the team behind the sql-eval harness

name: Chat2DB
description: Cross-platform, local-first database client and SQL workspace that uses a bring-your-own AI model to generate, explain, and optimize queries across 40+ databases.
features: AI SQL generation, explanation, and optimization
Commercial Pro/Enterprise editions add hosted AI and team features

name: DataLine
description: AI-driven data analysis and visualization tool that connects to Postgres, Snowflake, MySQL, SQLite, and CSV files and generates and executes SQL from natural language.
features: Postgres, Snowflake, MySQL, SQLite, and CSV sources

name: AI2sql
description: Transforms plain-English requests into SQL queries, optionally mapped to a database schema to construct statements.

name: SQL Chat
description: Chat-based SQL client that uses natural language to query and operate databases including MySQL, PostgreSQL, MSSQL, TiDB Cloud, and OceanBase.
features: MySQL, PostgreSQL, MSSQL, TiDB Cloud, OceanBase

name: LangChain SQL Agent
description: Documented LangGraph pattern for building a custom agent that answers questions about a SQL database using database tools and query-checking steps.
features: Pattern/framework capability, not a standalone product

name: LlamaIndex NLSQL
description: NLSQLTableQueryEngine constructs natural-language queries synthesized into SQL over a SQLDatabase wrapper, with response synthesis.

name: Haystack
description: Open-source AI orchestration framework whose official cookbook shows building a pipeline that generates SQL and queries a SQL database with a custom component.

name: Cube
description: Open-source semantic layer where metrics, dimensions, joins, and access rules are defined once and exposed through SQL, REST, and GraphQL APIs to BI tools, applications, and AI agents.
features: Semantic layer: metrics, dimensions, joins defined once
Commercial agentic analytics platform built on Cube Core

name: dbt Semantic Layer
description: Powered by MetricFlow, the dbt Semantic Layer lets data teams define metrics in the modeling layer and query them consistently in downstream tools; AI tools can connect through the dbt MCP server.
features: Consistent metrics across tools and agents
dbt MCP server for AI tools
Hosted layer requires a dbt plan

name: Malloy
description: Open-source semantic modeling and query language built on top of SQL that describes data relationships and transformations and executes through an existing SQL engine; models can be served via REST and MCP APIs.
features: Compiles to SQL on existing engines
Publisher serves models via REST and MCP APIs

name: Wren MDL
description: Wren AI's Modeling Definition Language: a versionable semantic contract describing models, relationships, calculated fields, and views, forming the governed context layer for WrenAI's text-to-SQL.
features: Part of the Wren AI stack

name: Supabase AI Assistant
description: Supabase's dashboard AI Assistant helps with schema design, SQL, RLS policies, functions, and error debugging, complemented by Supabase's MCP server for AI agents.
features: Dashboard AI for schema, SQL, and RLS

name: DBeaver AI Assistant
description: Generates and explains SQL from natural language and can act on databases through built-in AI tools and connected MCP servers; fuller AI Chat and tooling ship in PRO editions.
features: Built-in AI tools plus MCP client support

name: Snowflake Cortex Analyst
description: Generates SQL over structured data from natural language using a semantic view, and is available as a tool inside Cortex Agents.
features: Available as a tool in Cortex Agents

name: Databricks Genie
description: AI experience for asking data questions in natural language, with answers grounded in organization data governed through Unity Catalog (Genie Agents, formerly Genie Spaces).

name: Gemini in BigQuery
description: AI assistance in BigQuery Studio to explore data, chat with data via conversational analytics and data agents, and generate SQL and Python.
features: Several sub-features labeled Preview in official docs

name: Microsoft Copilot in Azure SQL Database
description: Conversational interface in the Azure portal to ask database questions and generate T-SQL using database context, DMVs, Query Store, and documentation.
features: Azure SQL Database only; Azure Data Studio retired Feb 28, 2026

name: Amazon Q generative SQL
description: Amazon Q generative SQL in the Amazon Redshift Query Editor recommends SQL from natural-language intent, analyzing query patterns and schema metadata.

name: MongoDB Compass Intelligent Assistant
description: Compass's intelligent assistant answers natural-language questions, helps debug errors, and uses read-only, user-approved tools to query the connected MongoDB deployment.
features: Read-only tools requiring explicit user approval
Works with connected deployments and Atlas

name: Oracle Select AI
description: Lets users interact with Oracle AI Database using natural language to generate, run, and explain SQL via DBMS_CLOUD_AI, with an agent framework via DBMS_CLOUD_AI_AGENT.
features: Natural-language to SQL inside the database

name: ClickHouse AI-powered SQL generation
description: From ClickHouse 25.7, ClickHouse Client and clickhouse-local convert natural-language descriptions into SQL using built-in schema-discovery tools.
features: Requires an Anthropic or OpenAI API key

name: pgAdmin AI Assistant
description: pgAdmin 4's Query Tool includes an AI Assistant tab that generates SQL from natural language by analyzing the database schema, after an AI provider is configured.
features: AI Assistant tab in the Query Tool

name: MCP Reference Servers (archived)
description: The original MCP reference servers, including the Postgres and SQLite reference implementations, are archived and no longer maintained; current servers live in modelcontextprotocol/servers.
features: Start here historically, not for production

name: Postgres MCP Pro
description: Community MCP server giving agents configurable read/write access to Postgres plus performance-analysis tooling.
features: Practical successor to the archived reference server

name: mcp-server-mysql (benborla)
description: Community Model Context Protocol server providing read-only access to MySQL databases: schema inspection and read-only queries for LLMs.

name: MongoDB MCP Server
description: MongoDB's official Model Context Protocol server to connect AI agents to MongoDB databases and MongoDB Atlas clusters.

name: ClickHouse MCP Server
description: ClickHouse's official MCP server for querying ClickHouse from MCP-compatible agents.
features: Works with ClickHouse Cloud and self-managed

name: MotherDuck MCP Server
description: MotherDuck's official local MCP server for DuckDB and MotherDuck.

name: Redis MCP Server
description: Redis's official MCP Server: a natural-language interface designed for agentic applications to manage and search data in Redis efficiently.

name: MSSQL MCP servers (community)
description: No official Microsoft SQL Server MCP server was verified on official Microsoft sources as of October 2026; community servers (for example RichardHan/mssql_mcp_server) exist and are unaudited.
features: Listed for discoverability; verify licenses before use

name: MCP Toolbox for Databases
description: Google's open-source MCP server for databases, providing prebuilt and custom tools across many database engines; the repo now points to googleapis/mcp-toolbox.

name: Supabase MCP Server
description: Supabase's official MCP server connecting AI assistants to Supabase projects and Postgres databases.

name: Neon MCP Server
description: Neon's official MCP server for interacting with the Neon Management API and databases using natural language.

name: AWS Labs MCP Servers for Databases
description: AWS Labs' official open-source MCP monorepo, including database servers for DynamoDB, Aurora PostgreSQL/MySQL/DSQL, DocumentDB, Neptune, and Redshift.

name: Snowflake MCP Server (Snowflake-Labs)
description: Snowflake-Labs' MCP server for Cortex AI, object management, and SQL orchestration — deprecated upstream in favor of Snowflake's official managed MCP server.
features: Migrate to Snowflake's official managed MCP server

name: Qdrant MCP Server
description: Qdrant's official Model Context Protocol server implementation for the Qdrant vector database.

name: PlanetScale MCP Server
description: PlanetScale's hosted MCP server exposing organizations, databases, branches, schema, and Insights data to MCP-compatible AI tools, with optional read/write query execution.

name: Turso MCP Server
description: Turso's hosted MCP server connecting AI coding agents to Turso Cloud to manage organizations, databases, and groups and run SQL, with OAuth login.

name: Hex Magic (Hex AI agents)
description: Hex's Magic AI features generate SQL, edit Python, and build charts and analyses from prompts using warehouse schemas and project context.

name: ThoughtSpot Sage
description: AI-powered search experience that lets users get insights from data through natural-language search using foundation models within ThoughtSpot's search technology; ThoughtSpot now also promotes the Spotter conversational experience.

name: Mode AI Assist
description: Generates SQL in Mode's SQL editor from natural-language comments embedded in queries, for any warehouse the user can query; enabled per account on request.

name: Metabase Metabot
description: Metabase's AI that gives answers, helps write queries, and can be extended via an AI agent API to query data.
features: Open-source edition; commercial editions separately licensed

name: Seek AI
description: Natural-language interface that queries structured data sources (including SQL Server, Snowflake, and other warehouses) and returns answers in plain English.

name: Julius AI
description: AI data-analysis tool that turns analysis into conversations: users upload files or connect databases and get visualizations without coding.

name: Dust
description: Agent platform whose Discover Knowledge capability explores data-warehouse tables and runs SQL analysis on Snowflake and BigQuery to answer quantitative questions.

name: Spider
description: Large human-labeled dataset for complex and cross-domain semantic parsing and the text-to-SQL task over relational databases.

name: Spider 2.0
description: Evaluates language models on real-world enterprise text-to-SQL workflows, with Snowflake, Lite, and DBT settings.

name: BIRD
description: Large-scale cross-domain text-to-SQL benchmark emphasizing database values, external knowledge, and query efficiency.

name: DAIL-SQL
description: Approach for optimizing LLM utilization on text-to-SQL through few-shot example selection and prompt organization; a method, not a dataset.

name: CHESS
description: Contextual Harnessing for Efficient SQL Synthesis: a multi-agent framework (information retriever, schema selector, candidate generator, unit tester) for text-to-SQL.

name: MAC-SQL
description: Multi-agent collaborative framework for text-to-SQL with selector, decomposer, and refiner agents.
features: No LICENSE file detected in repo

name: DIN-SQL
description: Decomposed in-context learning of text-to-SQL with self-correction: schema linking, classification, generation, and self-correction modules.

name: Defog sql-eval
description: The open evaluation harness Defog uses for evaluating generated SQL, built for reproducible comparisons.

name: KaggleDBQA
description: Challenging cross-domain evaluation dataset of real web (Kaggle) databases, with domain-specific data types, original formatting, and unrestricted questions.

name: CoSQL
description: Corpus for building cross-domain conversational text-to-SQL systems.

name: SParC
description: Semantic parsing and text-to-SQL in context: context-dependent, multi-turn questions built upon the Spider dataset.
